title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
description: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: Bulldog Courage
description: A young man, out to avenge his father's murder, prompts speedy action from the law.

title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
description: Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and vows to retake the land that once belonged to his forefathers.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E29 — Ghost Town Mystery
Pat and Stoney investigate the closing of a government silver mine.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E30 — Empty Mailbags
The agents travel to Central City to investigate the disappearance of two Postal Inspectors.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E31 — Sawdust Swindle
Stoney is charged with stealing a gold shipment and murder of an Indian chief's son.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E32 — Spring the Trap
Pat goes undercover as an outlaw to find stolen property.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E10 — Bedloe Strikes Again
Homer returns to Shady Rest in an attempt to scrap the Cannonball.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E11 — Uncle Joe's Replacement
General store clerk Herbie Bates, is name assistant general manager of the Shady Rest by Kate, making Uncle Joe feel like he is being replaced.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E12 — Honeymoon Hotel
Uncle Joe becomes a justice of the peace with hopes of attracting honeymooners.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E13 — A Night at the Hooterville Hilton
A brochure for the Shady Rest Hotel of the future is prematurely distributed.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:

A Texas Ranger is shot down in cold blood and Judge and Jeff are determined to break the case.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:

Judge Roy along with Taggart are intrigued by the arrival of Pat O'Hara and much younger wife Kate; Pat's fondness for drink and gambling has him involved with the town's rowdies.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E14 — Murder in Langtry
Deputy Jeff Taggart is framed in the murder of a horse trader.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E24 — Outlaw's Son
Judge Bean appoints himself as the legal guardian of a young man whose father was a member of an outlaw gang; the boy's uncle puts a bounty on his head.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E25 — The Reformer
Judge Bean's decisions displease some people, like prohibitionist Dolly Mason; she backs opposing candidate Duke Castle, an outlaw who claims he's reformed.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E06 — The Runaway
A young boy runs away from home because his father doesn't stand up to his abusive boss.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E07 — Slightly Prodigal
A woman arrives in town looking for her son; Roy finds out that her son is not only in the area, but has become a notorious outlaw.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E28 — Spirit of the Law
Judge Bean intervenes when the brothers Hart accuse each other of crimes including cattle rustling; the Judge feels something is wrong and wonders about Mr. Welles's involvement.

title: The Man From Music Mountain
description: A singing rancher (Gene Autry) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch swindlers selling lots in a ghost town.

title: Wildfire
description: Two horse-traders (Bob Steele, Sterling Holloway) find their problem is a rustler (John Miljan), not a wild horse.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Raiders of Red Gap
description: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

title: Land of Hunted Men
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, Dennis Moore, Max Terhune) track outlaws to their hide-out.

title: Fighting Caravans
description: A French girl (Lily Damita) joins a wagon train from Missouri led by two scouts and their young partner (Gary Cooper).

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: The Gunman From Bodie
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E17 — Dog Story
A dog leads Cisco and Pancho to his murdered master's gold mine where they become trapped by the victim's killers.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E18 — Confession for Money
Cisco proves that the man being held in jail on a murder charge is not the actual murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E19 — The Old Bum
A respectable businessman traps an elderly man into a rustling ring scheme that Pancho and Cisco later discover.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E20 — Haven for Heavies
Cisco and Pancho set out to prove that a notorious outlaw has murdered a U.S. marshal.

description:

An outlaw convinces the son of a former gang-member to join his gang.

description:

Matt's old friend, Tom Horn, turns into an outlaw and starts a land war.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E25 — Ben Thompson
Matt and Frankie look into Ben Thompson's background; Matt gets a job at a gambling den to obtain evidence about Ben's criminal activities.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E26 — Clay Allison
Matt arrests John Allison; Frankie's doctor is kidnapped; Clay falls into Matt's trap.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E26 — The Avenger
A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E29 — Bitter Water
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E30 — Feet of Clay
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E31 — Dark Star
Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

title: Yodelin' Kid From Pine Ridge
description: A singing cowboy rides to the rescue when a feud erupts between cattlemen and turpentine manufacturers.

title: Song of Arizona
description: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

title: Cry Blood, Apache
description: An old man (Joel McCrea) recalls his days as a young man (Jody McCrea) fighting Indians in the Old West.

description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: Hell Town
description: A rancher (John Mack Brown) makes his cousin (John Wayne) trail boss on a cattle drive headed for trouble.

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Colorado Kid
description: A cowboy (Bob Steele) framed for murder breaks out of jail to prove his innocence.

title: Loser's End
description: A cowboy (Jack Perrin) and his sidekick (Frank Rice) pursue a gang of smugglers and save a Mexican dancer (Tina Menard).

description: Jeb Stuart and George Custer get stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas and work together to stop abolitionist John Brown.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Phantom Ranger
description: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E06 — Oil Land
After being wrongfully jailed on a murder charge, Cisco and Pancho escape to capture the real murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E07 — Chain Lightning
Cisco is challenged by a man who seeks revenge after being jailed.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E08 — Medicine Flats
Cisco and Pancho hope to imprison the leader of a rustling ring.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E09 — Railroad Land Rush
A con man resorts to murder in a phony land promotion scheme.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E13 — Joaquin Murietta
The 1850s California gold fields are home to notorious bandit Joaquin Murietta; Matt and Frankie arrive to track him down, but he kidnaps Frankie; Matt and Captain Love trail Murietta to the bitter end.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E14 — Tiburcio Vasquez
Tiburcio Vasquez vows vengeance against Anglos after his sister Dolores is killed; Matt and Frankie try to stop his years of terror in Southern California after a railroad agent is killed with the help of a local priest.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E15 — Chief Crazy Horse
Matt enlists the aid of Dakota chiefs to bring in Crazy Horse.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E16 — Black Bart
The man behind a string of stagecoach robberies has remained out of reach of company detectives Matt and Frankie, but reinforcements from the city help to crack the case.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E24 — The Colonel and His Lady
Chief Black Wolf and his tribe are accused of breaking the treaty; it is up to Hawkeye and Chingachgook to clear them.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E25 — Washington Story
Surveyor George Washington aids a young woman whose land grant is threatened by a wicked innkeeper.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E26 — Winter Passage
Frontier wives hope to join their husbands in time for Christmas.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E27 — The Reckoning
More unrest between the white men and the Ottawas.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E28 — La Salle's Treasure
Fortune hunters seek a treasure rumored to have belonged to the French explorer La Salle; they ask Hawkeye to lead them but when he discovers that it is in a sacred Dakota burial ground he tries to dissuade them.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E29 — The Prisoner
Lt. Briggs breaks the treaty by chasing an Indian beyond the recognized border; led into an ambush he escapes but his militiamen are captured; Hawkeye and Chingachgook are assigned to escort him to his court-martial and probable hanging.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E30 — False Faces
A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent Mingo False Faces.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E31 — Morristown Story
Hawkeye has tracked outlaw Simon Girty to Morristown but he and Chingachgook are turned away and told that the town is closed due to an outbreak of the black plague; Hawkeye decides to sneak in and see for himself.

title: Wagon Wheels
description: An Oregon Trail scout (Randolph Scott) woos a member (Gail Patrick) of his wagon train in Indian country.

title: Under Western Stars
description: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

title: The Cowboy and the Prizefighter
description: Red Ryder KO's a fight racket with sidekick Little Beaver and a new friend.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

title: West of the Divide
description: Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

title: Wagon Trail
description: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

title: The Sundowners
description: Texas brothers (Robert Preston, Robert Sterling) feud over land and cattle, with a younger brother between them.

title: American Empire
description: Three men (Richard Dix, Leo Carrillo, Preston Foster) start a big cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas, but greed destroys it.

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Mason of the Mounted
description: A young constable searches for a murderer and finds the suspect managing a prosperous horse-stealing gang.

title: The Gay Cavalier
description: The Cisco Kid (Gilbert Roland) and Pancho (Martin Garralaga) try to help an unhappy bride.

description: Sgt. Renfrew (James Newill) and Constable Kelly (Warren Hull) are traveling on a cargo freighter when they meet Ann (Jean Carmen), a charming young woman who, unbeknownst to them, is part of a gang that plans to steal the freighter's gold shipment.

title: Sunset Carson Rides Again
description: A cowboy's partner tries to swindle him out of his land and the money he raised to build a new school.

title: Texas, Brooklyn and Heaven
description: A would-be playwright (Guy Madison) and a runaway (Diana Lynn) leave Texas and fall in love in New York.

title: Code of the Fearless
description: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Heartland
description: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.
